redzybedzy.text: RedzyBedzy plays a fast, clean game: ranks with the highest tracked across nearly every measure, a lively rhythm, and composed as fights harden. The numbers stay high as the opposition strengthens. Little ground is conceded against the strongest third. Lifetime numbers line up with the matchups, no daylight between them.

renamedsoldier12345.text: RenamedSoldier12345 has been at this since 2014, and it shows: sits at the very top of the board in nearly every count, fearless as the opposition strengthens, and patient of pace. The lifetime IvI line hugs the very bottom, a world away from the matchups, and the headshots are rare. The form barely dips against the strongest third, which keeps the story honest.

rage.text: Rage plays like a fire that never needs fuel: among the most relentless producers in the game, holding station near the very top, and valiant as the opposition sharpens. The aim and the headshots both hit near the top, which rounds out the picture. A storm who makes every exchange a race the other side cannot win.

railreplacementtransport.text: RailReplacementTransport shoots with a surgeon's eye: among the most driven fighters in the game, resting at the very top, and indomitable however hard the fight gets. Headshots sit at the very top, and so does the lifetime IvI, so the two boards line up. The edge keeps its shape against the hardest third too, sealing a complete card.

rebornlegendceresvs.text: Since 2016, rebornlegendCeresVS has played at full throttle: among the most productive in the game, in the top ranks of everyone tracked, and merciless when the fight toughens. The edge fades a touch against the hardest third, the one soft spot in an otherwise fierce card. A veteran who still brings the same fire every fight.

russianmysteriousairtraveler.text: RussianMysteriousAirTraveler wins the fights that matter and picks their moments: up with the very best tracked, with a matchup kill-death line among the very best. The headshots almost never come, and the lifetime IvI sits near the very bottom, which makes the matchup numbers the truer read. Precise where it counts, and calm against the hardest opposition.

renamed004260214.text: Since 2017, Renamed004260214 has played a patient, resilient game: among the elite, with a matchup kill-death number sitting near the summit and the shape holding against harder foes. The pace sits a notch below the very fastest, yet the results never suffer for it. The edge holds up well when facing the toughest foes, the mark of a resilient card.

retiredrageteller.text: RetiredRageteller plays a loud, fast game: in the top bracket, with shots flying at a blistering clip, with headshots that rank among the very best. The edge slips a little when the foes get toughest, the one soft note on a strong card. Read this one as a sketch drawn from an older, smaller opponent sample, not a finished portrait.

robanivisc.text: Robanivisc has been at it since 2013, and the matchup kill-death mark sits near the very top — the sharpest line on the card. The rating, activity, and resistance all land near the top, with bravery above average and a lifetime board to match. Consistency dips below average and headshots land mid-pack — small print on a veteran's strong record.

ra2tans0.text: Ra2taNS0 plays at full throttle: bravery and tempo both up near the very top, with resistance close behind them, and a matchup mark to match. The aim is precise, headshots claim a solid share, with the lifetime board rating them near the top too. Consistency sits mid-pack, the one quiet line on an otherwise loud card.

razinc.text: RaziNC leaves no soft spot on the card: rating, tempo, bravery, resistance, and matchup kill-death all stand near the very top of the tracked ranks. The aim is sharp, headshots claim a strong share of the attempts, and the lifetime board agrees with the matchups. Even against the strongest third, the results hold their shape, so this is a complete fighter, dangerous in every kind of exchange.

rwtravel.text: RWtravel is a patient hunter: pace only middling, bravery sitting near the very top; resistance among the very best tracked. The matchup kill-death mark rates among the best too, and the aim stays precise. Headshots are scarce, and the lifetime IvI lands mid-pack, and the matchups sit well clear of the lifetime board.

razitr.text: RaziTR plays a complete game at the highest level: matchup rating, activity, bravery, and resistance — every one near the very top. The matchup kill-death mark sits there too. Pace is relentless, the aim stays keen, and headshots make up a strong share of the shots. Against the strongest third the edge softens a touch, the one wrinkle in an otherwise full-strength card.

rwshuraarmorcn.text: RWShuraArmorCN plays a measured, durable game: matchup rating, bravery, and resistance near the top, and the duels break their way too. Activity runs above average, with the lifetime board concurring. The aim is mid-pack, headshots run above average, and the edge loosens slightly against the strongest third.

ragebaitingnc.text: RageBaitingNC is a force of nature: activity and bravery both at the very top, with a kill pace to match and aim that rarely misses. Headshots make up a huge share of the shots, and the lifetime board rates them even higher than the matchups do. Even against the strongest third, the game holds up — a complete card with no soft spot.

ragebaitingtr.text: RageBaitingTR plays at full throttle: kill pace and own pace both at the very top, with top-rank activity and bravery. The aim lands true, headshots plentiful, and the lifetime record tells the same tale. Against the strongest third, the game holds mid-pack — the lone soft spot in an otherwise first-rate card.

roborta.text: roborta plays a complete, high-tempo game: rating, activity, bravery, and resistance all in the top ranks, and the pace keeps up. The aim is precise, headshots above the pack, and the lifetime sheet matches the matchup picture. Even against the strongest third, the results hold up well — a steady hand across the whole card.

robertacumberland.text: RobertaCumberland is the oddest card in the pile: a young account whose accuracy sits at the very summit while the headshot share rests near the bottom. The matchups rate them near the top on nearly every line, yet the lifetime board barely registers a pulse. Body shots do the talking here, landing with clockwork regularity while the lifetime ledger stays silent. Early read, and already a riddle worth watching.

relymad.text: RelyMad arrived just now, and the first impression is thunder: accuracy among the very best tracked, tempo and bravery ride in the upper tier, with a matchup kill-death mark to match. The lifetime IvI already sits among the very best too. Consistency is near the bottom, so the game has yet to show it holds against the strongest third — but for a brand-new account, this is a remarkable opening.

restartxox.text: ReStartXoX plays a calm, collected game: rating and resistance hold the upper tier, with tempo and bravery in tow, the matchup kill-death mark staying near the top. The headshot share runs above average while raw accuracy sits mid-pack, so the damage lands where it matters. The lifetime IvI lands above average too, just a shade under the matchups.
